preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.splitlines()[0]) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: Both input lines (s and t) consist exclusively of lowercase Latin letters.
Both input lines (s and t) are non-empty.
Both input lines (s and t) have lengths not exceeding 100 characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if stdin.splitlines()[1] == stdin.splitlines()[0][::-1] else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if and only if the second line (t) is exactly the reverse of the first line (s).
